scripts.env: sh -c 'test -f apps/server/.env && echo "apps/server/.env already exists, skipping" || (cp apps/server/.env.example apps/server/.env && echo "Created apps/server/.env")'
scripts.legacy:env: sh -c 'test -f backend/.env && echo "backend/.env already exists, skipping" || (cp backend/.env.example backend/.env && echo "Created backend/.env")'
scripts.legacy:dev:backend: cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.legacy:db:upgrade: cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.legacy:db:seed: cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run python seed_skills.py
scripts.legacy:test: cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run pytest -v
